description:
A Tier-1 candidate proposition: a programmatically derived span within a
SourceSegment. The original segment is never rewritten -- `source_segment_id`
always points at the untouched Tier-0 text; `char_start`/`char_end` are offsets
*within that segment's text*, not into the whole document.

is_ambiguous.description: Set when the rule-based splitter could not confidently separate multiple clauses/claims -- a Tier-3 escalation trigger, not a Tier-1 semantic judgment.
is_ambiguous.title: Is Ambiguous

split_method.description: Which rule produced this candidate, e.g. "sentence_boundary", "semicolon", "conjunction", "relative_clause", "condition_marker", "list_item".
split_method.title: Split Method

text.description: The derived candidate span's own text, for convenience -- never rewritten.
text.title: Text

title: PropositionCandidate
